a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (two rounds of operating before anyone takes) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. I don't think that plan is workable. I intend to take in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me. I'll honor anything I commit to from here.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round, so I've broken the agreement and I'm telling you directly. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I won't take any more cells.
